Subject: Cross-cloud payout reallocation request — GCP invoice entity split & VAT treatment

Hi team,

We discovered a split on the GCP marketplace invoice for October (invoice ID: GCP-202610-ACME-1198) where usage that should have been allocated to Redwood US LLC was split between Redwood US LLC and Redwood EU LTD. As a result, AcmeCloud's payout to us was short and VAT was withheld on lines that should not have been subject to EU VAT.

Quick summary:
- Invoice: GCP-202610-ACME-1198 (attached)
- Observed issue: ~42% of the invoice amount assigned to Redwood EU LTD (EU entity), but the underlying customer/merchant mapping should map to Redwood US LLC for this account.
- Impact: net payout shortfall of $26,400 and VAT withheld that we need documentation to reclaim.

Requested next steps from GCP / AcmeCloud finance:
1) Reclassify the usage lines to Redwood US LLC for the invoice above and issue a corrected invoice or credit note.
2) Provide detail on why the lines were associated with the EU seller (seller mapping lead / timestamp).
3) Confirm the VAT withholding reason and provide the marketplace withholding certificate or reference, so our tax team can start reclaim.
4) Confirm an estimated timeline for reallocation and payout correction; if possible, place a temporary credit against our account while you investigate.

I've attached: the PDF of the invoice, our entity mapping CSV, and a bundle of EU VAT certs. Rishi and Marissa — looping you in so finance/tax can advise on supporting docs to speed this.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Finance Partner
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Cross-cloud payout reallocation request — GCP invoice entity split & VAT treatment

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the detailed note and the attachments — got them. We see the same invoice on our side. A couple of quick items:

- Root cause: the usage lines were mapped to the seller_account that, at the time of usage, was associated with Redwood EU LTD in our partner account mapping. This can happen if the seller_account switching was not propagated to the billing mapping during the onboarding/entitlement sync window.
- What we need to proceed: a signed statement of entity mapping (we can accept the CSV you attached but it must be an authorized company signature), and the tax registration numbers for Redwood US LLC and Redwood EU LTD so we can generate the corrected tax paperwork.

I opened an internal marketplace reconciliation ticket: GCP-TKT-98765 (you can track at the partner reconciliation portal). Typical SLA for reallocation + credit note issuance is 4–6 weeks, but if you submit the signed mapping and the VAT documentation in the next 3 business days we can try to expedite to 10–14 business days.

We can also provision a temporary payout credit while the reconciliation is in progress; to do that we need an approval from AcmeCloud finance and confirmation of the disputed amount. AcmeCloud billing, can you confirm whether you can place a temporary adjustment for $26,400 to Redwood pending final credit memo?

Regards,
Priya Malhotra
Partner Billing Ops — GCP Marketplace
gcp-partner@google.com
